memory.p1:
- Never commit signing keys or keystores.
- Use the design tokens; no hard-coded colours.
- Every screen needs an accessibility label.
- Release builds are cut from release/* branches only.
- 新しい画面には必ずプレビューを付ける。
memory.p2:
- Terraform changes go through plan review; never apply from a laptop.
- Tag every resource with owner and env.
- Do not open ports to 0.0.0.0/0.
- Rotate access keys, never share them in chat.
- Tag-only changes leave bucket access policies as they are.
- Tag-only changes leave instance sizes as they are.
memory.p3:
- Components live in src/components; one per file.
- No inline styles.
- Use the shared fetch wrapper for API calls.
- Write copy in the i18n files, not in JSX.
- 状態管理は既存の store を使い、新しい状態ライブラリを足さない。
